name: Kneaders Chunky Cinnamon French Toast with Caramel Syrup
whyItWorks: Famous thick slices of Kneaders Chunky Cinnamon bread dipped in egg custard and griddled soft. Refined flour and egg provide easily broken-down carbohydrates and gentle protein without rough seed fibers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for warm caramel syrup or maple syrup in moderation on the side. Skip whipped cream if lactose intolerant.
